questions.stem: Which of the following is a key feature of communalism?
questions.explanation: Collective ownership of resources is a fundamental aspect of communalism, contrasting with individual ownership.

distractorRationale.b: c: Authoritarian government is more aligned with fascism.
distractorRationale.c: d: Suppression of dissent is not a feature of communalism.

questions.stem: What is a primary characteristic of fascism?

distractorRationale.b: c: Communal living is more associated with communalism.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a welfare policy?
